name: USS Hornet Museum Volunteer (ages 16 and up)
org: USS Hornet Sea, Air and Space Museum
what_you_do: Restore aircraft or the ship, work in the radio room, do outreach, or help visitors. Teens 16 and 17 must have a parent or guardian with them.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and up for aircraft restoration, ship restoration, radio, community outreach and visitor services. If you are 16 or 17, a parent or guardian must stay with you at all times. Collections: 18 and up. Docents, events, security: 21 and up.
pay_detail: Unpaid. A background check is required: $30 through the museum, or bring your own from the last year.
duration: Set weekly shifts, for example Wed and Sat 8:30 to noon (aircraft), Tue and Sat (ship), first Saturday monthly (radio)
deadline_text: The page gives no deadline and does not say applications are rolling or ongoing. Apply through the volunteer form at volgistics.com or call (510) 521-8448 ext. 243.
how_to_apply: Apply at volgistics.com/appform/1737643431 or call (510) 521-8448 ext. 243.
notes: The parent or guardian must also apply and pass a background check. The form asks for 8 to 16 hours a month and a new volunteer orientation, held the first Saturday of each month at 10 AM. Ship work involves climbing ladders and tight spaces. Another museum page lists overnight programs for groups, but no teen intern program.
